contract.note: The launch-period scope and ordinary advertised-task reading are fair in context. The contract invents no numerical threshold and appropriately excludes the hedged expense component from scoring.

evidence.note: Contemporaneous independent testing supports reliability concerns, but its limited sample does not establish representative failure prevalence. Session issues and restricted tasks require separate treatment.

The dated company disclosure reports launch-model benchmark capabilities. These different measures do not establish dependable completion or repeated-trial consistency across ordinary advertised tasks.

reviews.rationale: The firm performance assertion is assessable, but the packet lacks representative launch-version testing sufficient to establish either frequent substantive failures or broadly dependable completion. The limited hands-on report supports concerns; company benchmarks do not settle their prevalence. The hedged expense assessment is not adjudicable.
